item.title: Lucky 7 Car Store Announces Donation Presentation to Honor Flight of Northeast Indiana
item.description: Lucky 7 Car Store announces the success of its Honor Flight campaign, raising $18,250 to support Honor Flight of Northeast Indiana.

item.title: Chris Bammerlin Files for Kosciusko County Council At-Large Seat
item.description: Chris Bammerlin, a Warsaw resident and owner of Real Property Management Golden Dome, has entered the race for the Kosciusko County Council at-large seat.

item.title: Navy Renames Indiana’s Largest Naval Installation
item.description: The Navy has renamed Naval Support Activity Crane as Naval Weapons Station Crane in a move intended to reflect the installation’s central role in weapons development, testing and munitions storage.

item.title: Kip Tom Not Running For County Council Seat
item.description: A list of candidates who have filed for local office in the May primary is showing Kip Tom filed Tuesday, Feb. 3, for Kosciusko County Council District 1.

item.title: Vacation In Wooster Approved at Kosciusko APC Meeting
item.description: The vacation in the unincorporated area of Wooster was brought back to the County Area Planning Commission meeting on Wednesday, Feb. 4.

item.title: Warsaw Community High School Juniors Named Indiana Rising Stars
item.description: Four juniors from Warsaw Community High School have been selected as Rising Stars of Indiana, a statewide honor recognizing students who demonstrate exceptional academic achievement, leadership and community involvement.

item.title: Noble County Tourism Report Shows $42M Generated
item.description: Tourism generated tens of millions of dollars in economic activity in Noble County during 2024, supporting hundreds of jobs and producing significant tax revenue despite an overall decline in visitor spending, according to a newly released economic impact study.

item.title: Need For Housing Emphasized At KEDCO Champion Breakfast
item.description: The need for housing within Kosciusko County to support local employers and their employees was emphasized during the second Kosciusko Economic Development Corporation Champion Breakfast.

item.title: Kosciusko APC Approves Two Ordinance Amendments
item.description: The Area Plan Commission at their regular meeting Tuesday, Feb. 4, brought up two ordinance amendments.
